title: Reject oversized SCHC floor records before persistence hashing
description: Security/robustness review of wm48 found restore_receiver_floor only checks record.len()>48 and calls the link commitment hash before exact record decoding. A corrupt local store can force unbounded hashing of an oversized record. Define the canonical fixed record length and reject all non-exact lengths before hashing/signature work; test oversized/truncated non-mutation.
notes: Defined canonical fixed SCHC floor-record length and rejects truncated/oversized records before commitment hashing or signature work; non-mutation cases covered. SCHC tests/clippy pass.
